director_brain_policy.selection_rule: direction authority and production mode are separate decisions and must be locked before production media generation
director_brain_policy.accepted_baseline_rule: an explicitly user-accepted full picture baseline must record locator, sha256, and acceptance statement and becomes protected production truth
director_brain_policy.accepted_source_library_rule: media explicitly accepted by the current user as canonical source material must separately record role, locator, sha256, acceptance statement, content_reuse_authorized=true, and timeline_locked=false; source-library acceptance does not mean the complete edit is accepted
director_brain_policy.refinement_rule: when refinement_scope.active=true, change only allowed_changes, preserve forbidden_changes, and do not restart/reinterpret canon when restart_authorized=false
director_brain_policy.recut_rule: when recut_scope.active=true, diagnose named defects first, use only allowed_changes, preserve forbidden_changes, keep accepted source canon intact, and do not silently replace the accepted source library
director_brain_policy.accepted_master_recovery_rule: an accepted master is itself a recoverable source of truth and may be analyzed to reconstruct lost production structure
director_brain_policy.accepted_source_recovery_rule: an accepted source library is canonical visual source truth and may be analyzed/extracted into traceable source-derived coverage while the timeline remains editable
director_brain_policy.sandbox_director_rule: The sandbox agent is Director/Editor/VFX Supervisor and must inspect real intermediate media; the runner executes approved plans but does not silently choose artistic direction.
director_brain_policy.jev_rule: Jev resolves Director intent to proven standard workflows, canonical tools and FX; Jev selection is not execution proof.
director_brain_policy.execution_proof_rule: Selected systems receive credit only when downstream execution/consumption is recorded in PRODUCTION_EXECUTION_LEDGER.json.

reference_policy.reference_role_rule: every visual reference must have an explicit authorized production role; style, motion-language, palette, composition, lighting, or effect references teach those properties only and do not authorize reuse of the reference subject, scene, source frames, or source footage as final-picture content unless the current user explicitly authorizes content reuse
reference_policy.accepted_source_library_conversion_rule: a reference becomes an accepted source library only through explicit current-user content-reuse authorization plus accepted_source_library identity/hash; never infer this state from reference presence
reference_policy.no_visual_reference_rule: before production media generation present at least three materially distinct numbered artistic-rendering routes in chat; each route must include a name, story interpretation, rendering/media treatment, production mode, and numbered mini-storyboard of at least three beats/frames; record all routes plus the current user's explicit selection/hybrid/modification in MEDIA_PLAN.json and lock the selection
reference_policy.no_visual_reference_decision_artifacts_r: concept/storyboard previews made solely for route selection are allowed before lock but are not production assets unless the selected direction explicitly adopts them

music_story_policy.lyrics_present_rule: preserve verified lyrics in LYRICS.md; present lyrics are directing authority by default unless the current user explicitly excludes them
music_story_policy.lyrics_exclusion_rule: if the current user explicitly excludes present lyrics from directing, keep lyrics.status=present, record directing_use=excluded_by_current_user plus the current user instruction, omit lyrics from SCRIPT.basis and lyric_cue fields, and use music analysis as primary directing authority
music_story_policy.no_lyrics_rule: music analysis becomes the primary directing authority unless the current user supplies a stronger current direction; absence of lyrics never permits skipping deliberate production-mode selection
music_story_policy.genre_rule: if genre/song type cannot be identified confidently, ask the current user before approach/story lock and record the user's declaration as authoritative
music_story_policy.script_rule: after storyboard lock and before shot packages, create SCRIPT.md and machine-readable SCRIPT.json covering the complete target frame range; every script entry must map story action, visual media, animation behavior, music cues, lyric cue when applicable, and transition
music_story_policy.preview_rule: a request to keep chat light or suppress previews must never be interpreted as permission to replace required production imagery with procedural placeholders; if the generation runtime surfaces image previews, those previews are allowed as part of producing real media

hero_library_policy.final_selection_rule: quality/perceptual-composition diversity selection; uniform interval may seed candidates but must not be the final selection rule

recipe_execution_policy.applies_to: Director Brain v3 music-led living_scene and hybrid productions
recipe_execution_policy.rule: A selected recipe must be evidenced by section proofs, actual effect applications, assembly evidence, final effect coverage, and production execution receipts. Declared available or gate-approved effects alone are not execution evidence.
recipe_execution_policy.intentional_absence_rule: A base, reactive, fill, or transition pass may be not_applicable only with a section-specific reason.
recipe_execution_policy.creative_waiver_rule: Deliberate sparse treatment must be declared in the recipe variation policy; it may not be inferred from missing passes.

asset_lifecycle_policy.canonical_replacement_rule: canonical assets may not be silently regenerated or replaced while canon_lock.locked=true

creative_acceptance_policy.current_user_rejection_rule: an explicit current-user rejection of a proof, media set, visual direction, or final export invalidates any prior accepted/final-QC status for the affected material; mark affected assets/proofs rejected, clear dependent acceptance booleans, and roll the project back to the earliest stage that must be redone without disturbing unrelated accepted canon

release_gate_policy.human_approval_authority: authenticated human GitHub issue comment identifying exact export and source SHA with complete normal-speed playback
